name: plinth-video
description: Plinth hackathon demo video, rendered from code with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render PlinthX out/render-x.mp4 && bash tools/finalize.sh out/render-x.mp4 out/plinth-x.mp4 && rm out/render-x.mp4
scripts.render:square: remotion render PlinthSquare out/render-sq.mp4 && bash tools/finalize.sh out/render-sq.mp4 out/plinth-x-square.mp4 && rm out/render-sq.mp4
